intent: The durable in-app inbox of product notifications: a bell with the unread count opens a kit Popover with the list, Mark all read and View all. Toasts stay for instant feedback; agent approvals live in AgentInbox.
useWhen: show payments, sign-ins and billing updates people can read later
an app header needs a bell with an unread count
a settings or activity page shows the same list in place (inline)
doNotUseWhen: instant feedback for an action just taken — Toast

items.note: { id, title, body?, createdAt, read, tone?: 'neutral'|'success'|'info'|'warning'|'danger', icon? }[]

inline.note: Render the panel in place, with no bell or popover.

onMarkRead.note: Called when an unread item is opened.

requirements: the bell is a kit Button named "Notifications, 2 unread"; the count chip is aria-hidden
the panel is the kit Popover dialog, named by label; Escape closes and returns focus to the bell
unread items say "Unread:" to screen readers, not just a bold title
new items fade and drop in on transform and opacity, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local NotificationBell or NotificationList
Do not restyle Toast as an inbox
Do not route agent approvals here — AgentInbox
